491950.short_description: Big Brother has arrived - and it’s you. Investigate the lives of citizens to find those responsible for a series of terror attacks. Information from the internet, personal communications and private files are all accessible to you. But, be warned, the information you supply will have consequences.

492180.name: Haimrik
492180.short_description: Make words come to life in this action adventure unlike any other! Haimrik blends gameplay with the narrative of its story set in medieval times. Combined with crisp humor and rare visual style, Haimrik’s journey is sure to entertain. Word’s the word!

492220.name: Bohemian Killing
492220.short_description: Paris, 1894. Class differences and pervasive racism finally lead to a tragedy. A year later you find yourself on trial, accused of a brutal murder. How far will you go to exonerate yourself? Will you lie? Manipulate the evidence? Frame others? Act insane? Confess? Your imagination is the limit.

492430.name: Alteric
492430.short_description: Jump through boiling lava; run from perilous traps and saw blades; glide and climb through catacombs; fall into the abyss and overcome gravity. And don't forget to switch to a parallel dimension in time, because it’s Alteric!

492500.name: Heroes of the Monkey Tavern
492500.short_description: Heroes of the Monkey Tavern is a first-person dungeon-crawling game designed as an introduction to the genre : simplified rules, balanced puzzles and challenges. An independent project developed solo.

492720.name: Tropico 6
492720.short_description: El Presidente is back! Prove yourself once again as a feared dictator or peace-loving statesman on the island state of Tropico and shape the fate of your very own banana republic through four distinctive eras.

493200.name: RiME
493200.short_description: A land of discovery stretches out before you. Explore the beautiful, rugged world of RiME. Armed with your wits and a will to overcome—and the guidance of a helpful fox—you must explore the enigmatic island, reach the tower's peak, and unlock its closely guarded secrets.

493310.name: Requiem: Avenging Angel
493310.short_description: Requiem: Avenging Angel is a 3D, first-person action game of biblical proportions set in a world under siege. A holy war rages on Earth between Heaven's Chosen Soldiers and Hell's Fallen Angels.

493340.name: Planet Coaster
493340.short_description: Planet Coaster® - the future of coaster park simulation games has arrived! Surprise, delight and thrill incredible crowds as you build your coaster park empire - let your imagination run wild, and share your success with the world.

493540.name: Figment
493540.short_description: Figment is an action-adventure game that invites you to explore a unique surreal universe filled with music, humor and multi layered narrative. Join Dusty and his ever-optimistic friend, Piper, on an adventure through the different sides of the mind seeking to restore the courage that's been lost.

493650.name: Deep Space Dash
493650.short_description: Deep Space Dash is a third person futuristic space runner. You are a convict in an intergalactic high-security prison, at an unknown location. You have managed to escape your cell but you are lost in a huge maze.

493700.name: Monster Puzzle
493700.short_description: Far away, lost in another dimension, there‘s a world where human dreams come to life. A land built upon sweet dreams where Trekkie and her friends live, safe from the bitter monsters inhabiting the dark world of nightmares.

493710.name: Laraan
493710.short_description: Laraan is a Science-Fiction game about exploration in a desolate world. Created with a minimalist low poly style. Accompanied by a splendid movie soundtrack.

493770.name: Awakened
493770.short_description: In this indie horror game dubbed - Awakened, you'll be playing sidescroller levels, first person view 3D environments, top down stealth levels, puzzles and more. You see, it's a series of minigames within the game and they're all tied together by a growing and riveting storyline that'll entertain you, challenge you, scare you, and keep...

493900.name: Dungeons 3
493900.short_description: At last, the Dungeon Lord has successfully united the forces of evil and established his dark empire. Time for the next step in his most diabolical quest: expansion!

494430.name: Praey for the Gods
494430.short_description: Praey for the Gods is a boss climbing open world adventure game where you play a lone hero sent to the edge of a dying frozen land to explore and solve the secrets of a never ending winter. Grapple, glide and grab hold of massive beasts as you fight to survive and return the world to proper order.

494580.name: STANDBY
494580.short_description: Never STANDBY in this fast-paced, precise platformer and get out of the glitched world! Can you do it faster than anyone?

494600.name: EARTH'S DAWN
494600.short_description: Earth’s Dawn is looming and the fate of the planet hangs in the balance! Dive into frantic side-scrolling combat and take the fight to the alien horde before destroying hulking bosses!

494720.name: Morphblade
494720.short_description: In Morphblade you move around a grid slicing, smashing and bursting waves of nasty red bugs. Each tile you move to transforms you into a different weapon: on a Blades hex you can slice enemies on either side of you, on an Arrow you can launch yourself through two enemies in a row.

494740.name: Police Quest™ Collection
494740.short_description: Walk the thin, blue line in four of the most realistic crime games ever created, packed with complex storylines and real-life mysteries that only a handful of real police officers ever face - or solve.

495700.name: Gabriel Knight: Sins of the Father®
495700.short_description: Gabriel Knight is the last in a long line of Shadow Hunters, those fated to fight the dark forces of the supernatural.

495780.name: Hexoscope
495780.short_description: Hexoscope is a new puzzle game that challenges your skills to create from Chaos. You should arrange the chaotic combination of hexagonal Chips to create a Chain from Power Source to Power Receiver. You should swap Chips with each other to combine their pins into solid Chain from Source to Receiver.

496300.name: Kingdom: New Lands
496300.short_description: Kingdom: New Lands builds upon the award-winning gameplay and mystery of Kingdom by introducing an abundance of new content to the IGF-nominated title while maintaining the simplicity and depth that legions of monarchs have come to experience and enjoy.

496340.name: Fighting Fantasy Legends
496340.short_description: Create your own adventures in a dangerous land of monsters, treasures and traps. From renowned authors Steve Jackson and Ian Livingstone (co-founders of Games Workshop) and Nomad Games, Fighting Fantasy Legends is a role-playing card game set in the world of Fighting Fantasy.

496390.name: Shiny
496390.short_description: Left to fend for himself after mankind abandoned the doomed planet Aurora, robot Kramer 227 must find a way through 20 action-packed levels and rescue his robotic friends before Aurora crashes into its sun.

496400.name: Renoir
496400.short_description: Renoir is a story-driven puzzle platformer that draws inspiration from classic 1940s film noir. Detective James Renoir has but a single shot to crack one hell of a case: his own murder!

496550.name: Noob Squad
496550.short_description: Kids, play Noob Squad and begin now to enter the ranks of the losers... the only important thing is to play and have fun!!! Yeeeeeeeeeeeeee!!!!11111ONE!!111

496620.name: Monster Slayers
496620.short_description: Monster Slayers is a rogue-like deck-building RPG adventure. Create a hero and choose your path through the perilous Northern Valley as you battle to become a true Monster Slayer.

496680.name: SweatShop
496680.short_description: SweatShop is a incremental game where you're the owner of a sweatshop, you have to hire more staff to work for you and sell products to gain more money. Buy many different upgrades for your workers and make even more money than before.

496690.name: Adventures On The Polluted Islands
496690.short_description: Adventures On The Polluted Islands – adventure game with elements of sandbox. You will play a small crab, armed with a boomerang. Help the survivors and go in search of salvation. Tasks, secrets, boss fights, easter eggs and much more are waiting for you!

496730.name: Sorcerer King: Rivals
496730.short_description: Explore a rich fantasy world, go on quests for powerful weapons, and forge a new civilization in Sorcerer King: Rivals. Can you build a civilization to topple the malevolent Sorcerer King and become a god yourself?

496760.name: The Beast Within: A Gabriel Knight® Mystery
496760.short_description: Play as both Gabriel and Grace as they are dispatched to Munich to solve a series of mutilation murders thought to be the work of werewolves.

496890.name: Replica
496890.short_description: Replica is an interactive novel game played through a cellphone and social media. The insane experience of peeping into someone's private life through a cellphone will transform you into the state's greatest patriot.

496980.name: Cosmic Cavern 3671　　宇宙最大の地底最大の作戦
496980.short_description: Cosmic Cavern was published in July 1980 by Takaya Arita, currently a professor at Nagoya University. This “Tactical Digging Game,” which existed two years prior to Dig Dug as the original sandbox game, has now been dramatically powered up!

497050.name: Shape Shifter
497050.short_description: You're a white, ever shifting shape. You need to find your way through the cracks. Use the holes punched by the ones that came before you. Make your way through the cracks, break through and create new holes by using the green elements. Enjoy the party.

497260.name: Fabulous Food Truck
497260.short_description: Fabulous Food Truck is an exciting time-management arcade game testing your skills and talent as Cook, Server and Manager of a busy food truck with a steady stream of demanding customers.

497270.name: MIGHT
497270.short_description: MIGHT is a team arena brawler with fun and fast-paced combat. Choose from many different classes, each with their own unique style. Classes are easy to pick up and play but mastering them is harder.

497360.name: Gabriel Knight® 3: Blood of the Sacred, Blood of the Damned
497360.short_description: Play as both Gabriel Knight and Grace Nakimura as you learn more about what is hidden in the hills of France.

497590.name: Sapper's bad dream
497590.short_description: The bomberman's nightmare. Or is it not a dream? Blow up the creatures before they try to kill you!

497700.name: Safety First!
497700.short_description: Safety First! is a twin stick physics puzzler in which you have to fix broken electric wires using your Magical Yellow Repair Liquid (MYRL). Can you beat all 69 levels?

498030.name: Barnyard Mahjong 3
498030.short_description: Barnyard Mahjong 3 takes you on a grand adventure around the farm playing challenging mahjong puzzles with farm-inspired animals such as horses, cows and chickens.

498040.name: The Hidden Dragon
498040.short_description: Fugo Rojo the Dragon loves to collect manmade objects and his eternal taste for treasure takes him on a journey to collect items from around the world.

498050.name: Mystery Of Rivenhallows
498050.short_description: Mystery Of Rivenhallows is an exciting adventure game full of mystery and suspense paying homage to the classic genre of point-and-click adventure gaming.

498240.name: Batman - The Telltale Series
498240.short_description: Enter the fractured psyche of Bruce Wayne and discover the powerful and far-reaching consequences of your choices as the Dark Knight.

498280.name: Jurassic Survival
498280.short_description: Jurassic Survival is an open-world survival game where players must cohabit with roaming dinosaurs.

498320.name: Trolley Gold
498320.short_description: Do you want to collect all the gold in the world? The game Trolley Gold gives you this opportunity!

498340.name: Shards of Azuria
498340.short_description: Shards of Azuria is an isometric, craft and build RPG. Create a character and a new world, then start your adventure by waking up in town. You are greeted by the locals of Azuria and begin to find your way around.

498360.name: Puzzle Nebula
498360.short_description: Puzzle Nebula is a mind-bending puzzle game set in the far corners of space.

498660.name: Mind Spheres
498660.short_description: Inspired by two not so different worlds, Mind Spheres brings you an exclusive and awesome experience. A physics puzzle with minigolf + pinball unique mashup. Figure out puzzles in order to proceed to the next level.

499420.name: Star Fields
499420.short_description: Star Fields is a casual, arcade style game with strategy and shooter elements. Simple, fast paced game-play, enjoy the original electronic/progressive/synth/retrowave soundtrack or import your own mp3s and listen to them while you play!

499520.name: The Turing Test
499520.short_description: The Turing Test is a challenging first-person puzzle game set on Jupiter’s moon, Europa. You are Ava Turing, an engineer for the International Space Agency (ISA) sent to discover the cause behind the disappearance of the ground crew stationed there.

499660.name: Medieval Kingdom Wars
499660.short_description: Rewrite medieval history through bloody siege combat in a fusion of RTS and Grand Strategy genres. Rule, build, and serve your King as a minor lord in medieval Europe. Experience siege, field and naval combat with an unseen degree of brutality. Rogue-like progression, epic towns and battles await…

499890.name: Aaero
499890.short_description: Trace ribbons of light to release the energy in the music as you speed through stylised alien worlds. Battle strange enemies and fight epic boss battles all driven by an incredible licensed soundtrack.

500570.name: Mahjong Deluxe 2: Astral Planes
500570.short_description: Mahjong Deluxe 2: Astral Planes is an out-of-this-world Mahjong game produced by award-winning game developer EnsenaSoft, challenging you to complete increasingly complex mahjong puzzles rendered in glorious 3D.

500580.name: Kitty Cat: Jigsaw Puzzles
500580.short_description: Kitty Cat: Jigsaw Puzzles is the puurfect game to cat lovers and jigsaw puzzle game enthusiasts. The game includes 84 challenging jigsaw puzzles with beautiful pictures of sweet, irresistible and adorable cats and kittens.

500590.name: Puppy Dog: Jigsaw Puzzles
500590.short_description: Puppy Dog: Jigsaw Puzzles is the perfect game to dog lovers and jigsaw puzzle game enthusiasts. The game includes 84 challenging jigsaw puzzles with beautiful pictures of irresistible cute puppies.

500810.name: Arcanum: Of Steamworks and Magick Obscura
500810.short_description: Imagine a place of wonder, where magick and technology coexist in an uneasy balance, and an adventurer might just as easily wield a flintlock pistol as a flaming sword. Welcome to the land of Arcanum.

501030.name: Extravaganza Rising
501030.short_description: Fortune favors those bold enough to collect and train tiny monsters.Three brave souls boldly descend into a town ridden with monsters, allies and everything in between. Driven only by the promise of powerful trinkets, unlimited treasure and almost certain death, they venture on.

501300.name: What Remains of Edith Finch
501300.short_description: What Remains of Edith Finch is a collection of strange tales about a family in Washington state. As Edith, you’ll explore the colossal Finch house, searching for stories as she explores her family history and tries to figure out why she's the last one in her family left alive.

501320.name: The Shrouded Isle
501320.short_description: Your Excellency, in this short systems-management survival game, we prepare for the awakening of our Lord. He hungers for human sacrifice. Sinners try to hide their dark secrets, but all must be purged...

501500.name: Black Moon Chronicles
501500.short_description: You are Wishmerill, a half-elf on a quest for power in a medieval world. Choose your side and lead your troops to victory!

501590.name: Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition
501590.short_description: Step into the boots of Grayson Hunt after a crash landing on an old resort planet forces him to make a hard choice: survival or revenge. Execute masterful kills with Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition’s unique combat system that rewards you for performing the most creative and deadly kills imaginable.

501970.name: Phantasmagoria 2: A Puzzle of Flesh
501970.short_description: All Curtis wants is to live a normal, happy life, but something seems to have other plans...

501990.name: Phantasmagoria
501990.short_description: Master storyteller Roberta Williams challenges you to experience the ultimate interactive nightmare.

502140.name: Drayt Empire
502140.short_description: Drayt Empire is a classic RPG. Ronarke and Drayt, best Friends on an adventure to seek out and find the lost forbidden City of Rahland. On their travels they will encounter many challenges which will test their friendship and strength.

502240.name: You Deserve
502240.short_description: "You Deserve" is an horror indie game in which you will experience a bullying story about revenge, starring a teenager called Amy who is lost in a world that she doesn’t know and her only objective is to escape from it without getting murdered.

502700.name: Laser Lasso BALL
502700.short_description: Laser Lasso BALL is the deadliest sport in the universe. Beings from across the galaxy battle to become stars in this Local Multiplayer Alien Deathsport.

502750.name: Quest for Glory 1-5
502750.short_description: The world of Gloriana, with all its wonderful diversity, awaits you.

503410.name: Zombie Camp
503410.short_description: Zombie Camp is a room-scale VR shooter! Experience 360 degree virtual reality shooting in a desperate attempt to protect your campsite from crazed ZOMBIES!!

503480.name: Mahluk:Dark Demon
503480.short_description: Mahluk is a hack and slash platformer game with pixel-art style graphics and retro style addicting gameplay.

503560.name: 911 Operator
503560.short_description: Game about the difficult work of people that manage emergency lines and services. Answer incoming calls and react properly - give first aid instructions, advise, dispatch correct number of firemen / police / ambulances, or sometimes - just ignore the call. Play on ANY CITY in the world!

503620.name: Fictorum
503620.short_description: Fictorum is an action RPG featuring destructible environments, a procedural node-based world map, and dynamic magic shaping.

503900.name: Candy Smash VR
503900.short_description: Satisfy your hacking and slashing needs in colorful and mushy candy world. Experience the most fun you can have with VR and HTC Vive controllers smashing stuff!

503940.name: Railway Empire
503940.short_description: In Railway Empire, you will create an elaborate and wide-ranging rail network, purchase over 40 different trains modelled in extraordinary detail, and buy or build railway stations, maintenance buildings, factories and tourist attractions to keep your travel network ahead of the competition.

504130.name: Manual Samuel - Last Tuesday Edition
504130.short_description: Wealthy, handsome, and... dead? Samuel strikes a deal with Death for one last shot at life, but only if he can survive a day doing everything manually. Blink, breathe, walk, and work - Guide Sam in this darkly humorous and brutally difficult adventure!

504230.name: Celeste
504230.short_description: Help Madeline survive her inner demons on her journey to the top of Celeste Mountain, in this super-tight platformer from the creators of TowerFall. Brave hundreds of hand-crafted challenges, uncover devious secrets, and piece together the mystery of the mountain.

504430.name: The Watchmaker
504430.short_description: The Watchmaker is an action adventure set in a strange steampunk world of giant clock mechanisms, where time has gone mad. Join Alexander, a clock tower keeper, on his quest to restore time to its natural rhythm!

504460.name: Team Racing League
504460.short_description: In this unique 3 on 3 racegame, it's up to you and your teammates to finish before the opposing team does. Mastering the high quality vehicle handling, special abilities, and optimal Team Strategy are key to win the race.

504490.name: The God's Chain
504490.short_description: Finally the day came when we found our GOD.Human Beings are an experiment done by them.The human beings are evolving and have become one of the greatest powers in the universe which is becoming a great problem for other colonies in the universe.So our god decides to end the experiment but now human beings will fight for their existence.

504800.name: Sorcery! Part 4
504800.short_description: An epic adventure through an open world of monsters, traps and magic. Infiltrate the Fortress of Sorcerers, and create your own unique story where every decision you make is remembered, no matter how small. Cheat death, uncover ancient mysteries, and recover the Crown of Kings - if you can.

505170.name: Carmageddon: Max Damage
505170.short_description: CARMAGEDDON: MAX DAMAGE is HERE! And it's the antidote to Racing Games.

505210.name: Neon Space 2
505210.short_description: Neon Space 2 is a highly anticipated sequel to Neon Space. The game kept all the elements from his predecessor, but at the same time the visuals received a major improvement.

505230.name: Pathologic 2
505230.short_description: Pathologic 2 is a groundbreaking open-world horror RPG. Resist the plague. Make medicine. Heal people. Perform an autopsy. Trade to get what you need. Fight and kill if necessary. Survive. Struggle with an outbreak in a secluded rural town that is rapidly turning into hell.

505330.name: Apocalipsis
505330.short_description: Apocalipsis is a point-and-click adventure game, in the vain of Samorost and Machinarium, where all puzzles have a hidden meaning. With a unique artstyle inspired by 15th century engravings it tells a story about heartbreak, redemption and, quite literally, the end of the world.

505630.name: Let Them Come
505630.short_description: Let Them Come is a fast paced pixel art shoot ‘em up. Twitchy trigger fingers and focused battle tactics are the order of the day as wave after wave of alien-like creatures try to take you down.

505730.name: Holy Potatoes! We’re in Space?!
505730.short_description: Holy Potatoes! We’re in Space?! is a whacky space exploration game where you manage your very own spaceship, craft hundreds of weapons, and explore the vastness of a veggie-filled universe.

506870.name: Unexplored
506870.short_description: The ROGUELITE that feels like a ROGUELIKE. Praised for its fantastically generated dungeons, real-time combat and surprising amount of content and depth. One of the BEST GAMES OF THE YEAR according to PC Gamer and VICE Waypoint.

507030.name: Bicyclism EP
507030.short_description: Bicyclism EP is a physics based party game for up to 4 split-screen players. Play as your favorite bicycle and compete in traditional bicycle games like racing, jousting, soccer, space mushroom hunting, wrestling, etc.

507120.name: The Superfluous
507120.short_description: "The Superfluous" [soo-pur-floo-uh s] A cave-diving, sci-fi, rogue-lite, platformer with jet packs and lots of explosions. Help stop an apocalyptic asteroid on collision course with Earth. Lead a squad to the center of the asteroid and blast it into space dust.

507340.name: Strike Squadron: Caracará
507340.short_description: Story-driven 2D Space sim inspired by 90's space sims. You are not an ace pilot, nor is your squadron the best of the best. You just want to do your job, whatever the cost.

507380.name: Black Sand Drift
507380.short_description: For over 300 years, the five planets of the Kotiro galaxy have struggled under the heavy hand of maniacal, mechanical bots called Spiral. As the metallic army's relentless pursuit of the resource Black Sand begins ramping up exponentially, a few brave heroes decide to fight back.

507390.name: Gone In November
507390.short_description: Coming home after visiting your doctor for the last time, you are told that you only have three more days to live. A sequence of short memory fragments flashing through as you try to run away from what you have done.

507400.name: Vindictive Drive
507400.short_description: Vindictive Drive is an Action/Stealth game about Arris Fern's cold blooded revenge against her father, the president of the most powerful nation, for the assassination of her mother. Consumed by hatred, Arris will use the most cruel methods at her disposal to achieve her goal.

507490.name: Ashes of the Singularity: Escalation
507490.short_description: A massive-scale real-time strategy game where you command entire armies on a dynamic battlefield. Conquer multiple worlds across several single-player campaigns; or play with your friends in multiplayer combat.

508170.name: BlackSmith HIT
508170.short_description: BlackSmith HIT – Hit the iron when it is hot! And show who is the real blacksmith!

508180.name: Fly and Destroy
508180.short_description: Fly and destroy is a space arcade unlike anything you've experienced before. It combines extremely fun game mechanics with breath taking visuals. The game itself has elements of almost every popular indie genre, but probably the most fitting would be the space bullet hell.

508290.name: $1 Ride
508290.short_description: $1 Ride is a casual game with a fast paced, timing and reflex testing game-play style. Travel through space at warp speed! Collect power ups to increase your speed or risk your fuel to collect money, missiles and more.

508440.name: Totally Accurate Battle Simulator
508440.short_description: Be the leader of wobblers from ancient lands, spooky places, and fantasy worlds. Watch them fight in simulations made with the wobbliest physics system ever created, make your own wobblers in the unit creator and send your army off to fight your friends in multiplayer.

508530.name: HackyZack
508530.short_description: You are Zack. Juggle balls with unique properties through platforming puzzles to a goal at the end of each stage. Help Zack fill his treasured book of stickers to unlock optional challenge levels, where you race against the timer to destroy targets as fast as possible.

508790.name: Flat Heroes
508790.short_description: Dodge, jump, and dash your way through hundreds of terrifying geometric levels and epic bosses. Too tough? Bring your friends!

508910.name: Deus Ex Machina, Game of the Year, 30th Anniversary Collector’s Edition
508910.short_description: Back by popular demand, the legendary video game and first ever interactive movie, starring Jon Pertwee (Doctor Who), Ian Dury (the Godfather of Punk), and Frankie Howerd (comic genius). Hailed as a breakthrough in the development of video games, Deus Ex Machina won Game Of The Year, and is currently the subject of movies, books,...

508980.name: Crashday Redline Edition
508980.short_description: Crashday, the explosive cult classic multiplayer racer, is back! Retooled and remastered, Crashday: Redline Edition brings back the fun and memories of the original with this lovingly crafted tribute edition, featuring all-new and expanded features, including Steam Workshop support. Today is Crashday!

509110.name: Spikit
509110.short_description: Spikit is a bullet hell game developed by a single developer, Igor Petrović. With a soundtrack composed by Dario Malešević. In this game, the player will have to dodge a constant barrage of spikes coming from the side of the screen.

509580.name: The Lord of the Rings: Adventure Card Game - Definitive Edition
509580.short_description: Build a deck of iconic heroes and challenge the forces of Sauron in this thrilling tactical card game. Travel through famous locations, complete story-driven quests and forge a new legend of Middle-earth on your own or with a friend in cooperative mode.

510330.name: Shotgun Raiders
510330.short_description: Polish your Shotgun and pull some Grenades because its time for SHOTGUN RAIDERS! A 2d fast action platform shooter with Trading Cards. Inspired by the easy controls of classic mario, limited gun angles of the good old arcade shooters, and level crafting.

510390.name: Unknown Fate
510390.short_description: Unknown Fate is an enigmatic story-driven action adventure set in a surreal world full of mind-twisting puzzles and bizarre creatures

510420.name: The Hex
510420.short_description: In a creaky old tavern, in a forgotten corner of the video-game universe, a storm is raging. An anonymous caller suggests that there is a murder plot. Six video game protagonists are the only plausible suspects...

510570.name: Curse
510570.short_description: CURSE is a point-and-click horror game that throws the player into the world of paranormal investigations.

510620.name: THOTH
510620.short_description: THOTH is a challenging twin-stick shooter you can conquer alone or cooperatively with a friend. Each stage is handcrafted to test coordination and puzzle-solving skills. Colorful minimalist graphics combine with an intense unnerving soundtrack, making for an exciting mix of art and arcade.

510840.name: Evolvation
510840.short_description: Evolvation is a casual multiplayer and fast-paced and class based space flying shooter developed by a two-man-army (Eric and Jacob) from Amsterdam. Classes are: Highspeed, Fighter, Stealth, Support and Tank. Each class has its own special ability which provides a dynamic gameplay.

511470.name: Glass Masquerade
511470.short_description: Welcome to Glass Masquerade - an artistic puzzle game inspired by Art Deco & stained glass artisans of the 20th century. You need to combine hidden glass pieces to unveil clocks and themes exhibited by various cultures of the world at the 'International Times Exhibition'

511630.name: Max, an Autistic Journey
511630.short_description: Max, an Autistic Journey is a retro style top-down turn-based RPG filled with mini games, monsters and most of all, heart. Developed by a devoted dad who made a game with his son about his son's autism.

511750.name: Showdown Adventure
511750.short_description: Take part in awesome, funny adventure on unfriendly, dangerous island! Defeat monsters, discover big world and collect unique items.

511820.name: Le Havre: The Inland Port
511820.short_description: Build a prosperous port in Uwe Rosenberg’s award winning two-player board game!

512020.name: Box Maze
512020.short_description: Jump into the life of Cubert, and help him reach his true love as you find your way through unique levels without being destroyed by your enemies as well as other obstacles, encounter new enemies and bosses as you climb the levels, collect cupcakes for your love along the way as you find hidden secrets.

512250.name: Oh...Sir!! The Insult Simulator
512250.short_description: A Hilarious Insult-‘em up in which players must verbally take-out their friends and family in different game modes. Assemble witty insults using different word strings, and employ combos, criticals, continuations and more to battle your opponents both offline and online across multiple devices.

512300.name: Unbox: Newbie's Adventure
512300.short_description: Unbox: Newbie's Adventure is a 90s style 3D platformer about the ultimate postal service, self-delivering cardboard boxes! Unbox: Newbie's Adventure has giant worlds full of challenges, collectibles and boxy boss battles!

512550.name: Cursed West
512550.short_description: Cursed West contains the spirit of Glories of the past, Holding aspects such as Difficulty and Mechanics. Adding more modern visuals in both, levels with traditional 2d gameplay, as in the 3d levels

512640.name: Final Quest
512640.short_description: A time of change is coming. One small boy, the last of a long line of Gem Warriors, will soon discover the true power of his heritage. In so doing, he will embark upon a Final quest to free the people and to find his long lost father.

512740.name: Flat Path
512740.short_description: Relaxing puzzle game in a minimal style.

512790.name: Quern - Undying Thoughts
512790.short_description: Discover the truth about Quern’s past, unfold the mysteries of its present, and be the explorer who shapes its future. Quern introduces reusable puzzle mechanics to the classic genre, making the player think about the game as a whole, and not just as a series of individual challenges.

512900.name: Streets of Rogue
512900.short_description: Fight, sneak, and hack your way through randomly generated cities. It's like Nuclear Throne meets Deus Ex, mixed with the anarchy of GTA. Rogue-lite meets immersive sim, and goes completely insane.

513290.name: Lucius III
513290.short_description: Lucius is back. In a whole new narrative experience, he now returns to his old neighborhood of Winter Hill. The path will be a difficult one, with trials and tribulations waiting ahead. Has he made the right choices? Is it finally time to end it all?

513330.name: Party Tycoon
513330.short_description: Manage your dream nightclub in Party Hard Tycoon, a business simulation game where you're tasked with throwing the most profitable party ever. It takes place in the same universe as tinyBuild's 2015 hit Party Hard.

513340.name: Through Abandoned: The Forest
513340.short_description: You continue your journey in worlds of Abandoned.

513360.name: Mu Cartographer
513360.short_description: Colourful sandbox toy - Experimental treasure hunt. Manipulate an abstract machine to shape and explore colourful landscapes, and find the mysteries hidden in a shifting world.

513420.name: VR Escape The Space Station
513420.short_description: You are trapped in the space station all by yourself. Need to find a way to get the hell out of there. Experience with HTC Vive, consists of 4 rooms full of puzzles. Every scene are elaborately designed including spaceship with zero gravity, outer space landscape corridor and all.

513580.name: Miaou Moon
513580.short_description: Rise to the challenge and play Captain Miaou, lost in space. Survive by grabbing energy food to propel yourself and gain enough speed momentum. Fight gravity and bump away through 5 worlds of various physical obstacles. Time your jumps accordingly, upgrade your catsuit and scratch at will !

513590.name: So Many Cubes
513590.short_description: A chaotic strategy game with cubes! You have to choose and build deployments to destroy the Mothercube with So Many Cubes

513610.name: Madrobot X
513610.short_description: MadRobot X is an old school shoot 'em up game. You control a robot trying to escape from the laboratory of a mad scientist, and to accomplish this, you'll need the help of GoboGobo, another robot who also wants to escape.

513620.name: SkyTime
513620.short_description: SkyTime is a 3D platformer in which you slow time, dodge bullets, destroy turrets and overcome obstacles! If you ever played Superhot or Cluster Truck, this game combines them both!

513690.name: Danger Zone 2
513690.short_description: Danger Zone 2 takes the crash action out of the Test Area and onto real public roads. A high speed driving game featuring speed, boost, traffic and crashes.

513740.name: Joana's Life
513740.short_description: In a peaceful part of the town, a series of deaths occur, seemingly random at first, but gruesome in their nature. One day, you find an object that doesn't belong in your house. An old, worn-out, stained mirror. You'll come to discover that the simple mirror isn't the only thing that is out of place.

513780.name: Turbo Pug DX
513780.short_description: Turbo Pug is back and better than ever! In Turbo Pug DX you'll explore a variety of beautiful, passionately crafted environments. Collect treasures, score boosters, unlock other creatures to play as. Unlock secret mini games. Create custom level skins or enjoy skins created by other players.

514150.name: Line of Sight: Vietnam
514150.short_description: Every day brings another mission. Every day is LIFE or DEATH. Be quick, be quiet and be careful. That’s what will get you HOME ALIVE.

514170.name: 18 Wheels of Steel: Convoy
514170.short_description: Take the wheel of a fast paced, high intensity trucking business. Start as a one man show, bidding on jobs, then build your fleet into an unstoppable convoy and deliver the goods. Grow your business and your fleet, but beware - your reputation is everything.

514240.name: ALONE?
514240.short_description: Explore and experience this horror story, as you embark on an ghostly adventure unlike anything you have played before. Come face-to-face with terror itself as you look for your missing sister.

514470.name: Fantastic 4 In A Row 2
514470.short_description: Fantastic 4 In A Row 2 is a modern version of the timeless classic, played on a distant planet with beautiful graphics and music. Participating players take turns dropping colored discs from the top of the screen into a vertically suspended grid.

514480.name: Fantastic Checkers 2
514480.short_description: Fantastic Checkers 2 is a modern version of the classic strategy board game set in an extraterrestrial environment! The objective of the game is to capture opponent pieces by diagonally jumping over them to eliminate them from the board.

514490.name: Ultimate Word Search 2: Letter Boxed
514490.short_description: Ultimate Word Search 2: Letter Boxed takes you into a world of mystery where your task is to locate hidden words in a matrix of letters. Each matrix contain words that wrap around a 3D-cube going left, right, up and down.

514620.name: Ellipsis
514620.short_description: Ellipsis is an action-packed Avoid ’Em Up with minimalistic, yet powerful neon styled visuals. Guide your ship through a mysterious universe while deftly avoiding hordes of roaming enemies, spikes, lasers and more.

514660.name: BitMaster
514660.short_description: BitMaster is a dynamic and colorful twin-stick shooter which design was inspired by such games as Geometry Wars, Crimson Land and Satellite Reign. Game powered by Unreal Engine 4!

514890.name: Super Jagua
514890.short_description: Super Jagua is a classic 2D retro-style single-player platformer inspired by the greatest platformers of the 80s. Run, jump, swim, discover lots of secrets, fight brutal bosses and more in this classic NES inspired adventure.

514900.name: >observer_
514900.short_description: The original first‑person cyberpunk horror detective tale set in a decaying, neon‑scarred future. As an Observer who invades minds to hunt for clues, you will sift through corrupted memories to track down a mysterious killer and confront your own dark past.

514970.name: Drive Megapolis
514970.short_description: Improve your real life driving skills! Drive Megapolis is designed to be interactive and also a learning opportunity. Tracking your driving mistakes and clearly highlighting them, allowing you to learn and improve. With a huge variety of vehicles with unique driving styles, maps, pedestrians and traffic.

514990.name: Outbreak
514990.short_description: Race against the clock and battle the undead in this co-op survival horror nightmare.

515470.name: Hyper color ball
515470.short_description: Hyper color ball is a casual, difficult game. The game-play mechanics are based on testing your focus and dexterity skills. With a fast paced, upbeat soundtrack and a strong vibrant colours. Hyper color ball makes for a fantastic party game.

515570.name: UBERMOSH Vol.3
515570.short_description: The third volume of the arcade series UBERMOSH.

515690.name: Warriors of Vilvatikta
515690.short_description: Warriors of Vilvatikta is an epic RPG inspired by real Indonesian history.

516040.name: Everything is Peachy
516040.short_description: Control a colony of peaceful, peach fueled robots in a fast-paced roguish resource gathering game, explore the galaxy as you choose your route to the center to face the ultimate showdown, and hopefully… everything will be peachy.

516110.name: ToeJam & Earl: Back in the Groove!
516110.short_description: ToeJam & Earl: Back in the Groove! is a mash-up of the very best features of the classic console games with a ton of fresh improvements! Explore Earth as funky aliens from planet Funkotron trying to find your missing ship pieces to get back home in this casual co-op roguelike.

517630.name: Just Cause 4 Reloaded
517630.short_description: Rogue agent Rico Rodriguez journeys to Solis, a huge South American world home of conflict, oppression and extreme weather conditions. Strap into your wingsuit, equip your fully customizable grappling hook, and get ready to bring the thunder!

517710.name: Redout: Enhanced Edition
517710.short_description: Redout is a tribute to the old racing monsters such as F-Zero, WipeOut, Rollcage, and POD. It is designed to be an uncompromising, fast, tough and satisfying driving experience, soaked in that vertigo that stands at the core of the arcade racing genre.

517790.name: Caesar™ 3
517790.short_description: Prove your strength of mind and spirit and you just may be crowned Caesar!

517810.name: Caesar™ IV
517810.short_description: Starting as governor of a newly formed province in the Roman Empire your goal is simple: advance up the empire's political ladder to become the next Caesar.

518060.name: Chess Ultra
518060.short_description: Introducing Chess Ultra; the most breathtaking chess game ever made. Experience stunning 4K visuals, seamless online multiplayer, Grandmaster approved AI and full VR compatibility.

518120.name: Chimpact 1 - Chuck's Adventure
518120.short_description: Luscious environments with a variety of delightful characters make Chimpact top of its class. Collect gems, medallions and bananas by chucking your chimp through stunning jungle landscapes. Use bananas to add abilities to your chimp and complete all levels perfectly.

518620.name: Ballistick
518620.short_description: The stick figure days are back! Ballistick combines tactical combat, over-the-top gore, and realistic gun mechanics to create an experience like no other. Lock, load, and get ready to relive the glory days of stick figure combat.

518670.name: Intensive Exposure
518670.short_description: Intensive Exposure is a fast paced game in which you have to expose yourself as many times as possible without getting caught by security.

518920.name: Surgeon Simulator: Experience Reality
518920.short_description: Surgeon Simulator is bringing the ER to VR! The most critically acclaimed and infamous surgery simulation game as you have never seen it before! Featuring all of the surgeries and twisted humour of the original favourite plus a few new surprises...

519860.name: DUSK
519860.short_description: Battle through an onslaught of mystical backwater cultists, possessed militants & even darker forces as you attempt to discover just what lurks beneath the Earth in this retro FPS inspired by the '90s legends.

520250.name: Visitors
520250.short_description: When you buy a country farm you should be ready for anything, even an alien invasion. A house far from civilization is all our hero has ever dreamed of, and it just so happens that a juicy offer has presented itself.

520270.name: Thrills & Chills - Roller Coasters
520270.short_description: Forget about other roller-coasters rides and experience real Thrills & Chills with this Virtual Reality coaster. Continuously updated with new tracks and environments, this is a must have for every roller coaster fan!

520440.name: GUILTY GEAR Xrd REV 2
520440.short_description: Astonishing 3D cell animations and overwhelming content volume, the next-generation fighting game "GUILTY GEAR Xrd REV 2" is now out on Steam! Total cast of 25 unique characters, and tons of game modes, get ready to ROCK!

520600.name: Purrfect Date - Visual Novel/Dating Simulator
520600.short_description: As Cat Island’s newest arrival, it’s not long before you realise something’s seriously amiss, or should we say… amorous! A blend of mystery, intrigue and wickedly black humour, will you discover your Purrfect Date before it’s too late? Remember, curiosity killed the cat...

520720.name: Dear Esther: Landmark Edition
520720.short_description: Dear Esther immerses you in a stunningly realised world, a remote and desolate island somewhere in the outer Hebrides. As you step forwards, a voice begins to read fragments of a letter: 'Dear Esther...' - and so begins a journey through one of the most original first-person games of recent years.

521210.name: Timore 5
521210.short_description: Timore 5 is an indie horror game, 5th one in Timore series. A scientist named Frank has done a lot inventing new things, but his experiments aren't without the consequences. In this game Frank will try to record his dreams and convert them to computer data, allowing him to review his dreams later, but the experiment might not go as...

521230.name: Stone Age Wars
521230.short_description: Stone Age Wars is an RPG arcade game where you assemble a team of prehistoric soldiers, each with unique abilities and go up against waves of vicious enemies.

521880.name: RPG Maker VX
521880.short_description: RPG Maker VX allows you to make the role-playing games you’ve always dreamed of by being one of the easiest game engine software ever developed. With its enhanced auto-tile capabilities, quick event creation, and dungeon generator, you can have a game ready to play faster than ever before!

521890.name: Hello Neighbor
521890.short_description: Hello Neighbor is a Stealth Horror Game about sneaking into your neighbor's house and figuring out what he's hiding in the basement. Play against an advanced AI that learns from your actions.

521920.name: Death's Hangover
521920.short_description: Death's Hangover is a ball and bat game, featuring horror elements, mature comedy and themes.

521990.name: Galactic Storm
521990.short_description: Galactic Storm is a top down shoot'em up. It features distinct weapons, fast action and epic boss battles.

522010.name: Lost Crew
522010.short_description: This is text adventure game of survival of the astronauts on the orbital station that is lost in time. You will have to take care of the rescue of the station's crew, and lots of complicated riddles and situations will make this adventure even more interesting.

522040.name: Princess Remedy 2: In A Heap of Trouble
522040.short_description: An enormous Boss Tower has sprung from the ground, lifting entire towns up with it. Now, the people living on the tower are starting to contract all sorts of mysterious illnesses. Princess Remedy, still in Saturnian healing school, must use her powers to heal everyone and defeat the Boss Tower!

522210.name: Serial Cleaner
522210.short_description: Slip on your flares, grab your shades and hop in your station wagon, it's time to work… as a professional mob cleaner. In this stylish award winning 2D action-stealth game you have to make sure you get in, clean up and get out without leaving a trace - Queue the funky 70s inspired soundtrack!

522240.name: Pool Panic
522240.short_description: Pool Panic is an unconventional billiards game with something new around every corner. It's the world's least realistic pool simulator!

522570.name: The Last Hope
522570.short_description: You’ve made the biggest mistake in history. Now, you're the last hope. Explore the UK, Russia, Germany, Norway, Egypt, USA, Mars, and the Moon. Search for food, face creatures, travel through time, and fight to restore humanity. Survive or perish—your choices shape the future.

522690.name: In Fear I Trust
522690.short_description: In Fear I Trust is a critically acclaimed first-person horror adventure. Explore eerie locations, solve puzzles and unravel the dark truth behind a secret soviet experiment in this story-driven psychological thriller.

523150.name: Mahjong World Contest (麻将)
523150.short_description: Join a Mahjong contest. Complete over 100 unique levels to gain experience and points. Improve your rank and progress.

523160.name: Alice's Patchworks 2
523160.short_description: Assemble patchwork mosaics, meet your favorite heroes from the world beyond the looking glass and help Alice become the queen!

523650.name: Lust for Darkness
523650.short_description: A psychological horror of seeking satisfaction on the border of two intertwining worlds. An intriguing plot with erotic and occult themes guides the player's character through the Yelvertons' Victorian mansion and a perverse land inspired by Lovecraft's works and paintings of Zdzisław Beksiński.

523780.name: Emily is Away Too
523780.short_description: Emily is Away Too is a brand new story featuring new characters and multiple different endings. Message your friends, surf the web and choose your path through this branching narrative.

524220.name: NieR:Automata™
524220.short_description: NieR: Automata tells the story of androids 2B, 9S and A2 and their battle to reclaim the machine-driven dystopia overrun by powerful machines.

524640.name: Asura: Vengeance Edition
524640.short_description: Asura is an Action Rogue-like set in a fantasy world inspired by the richness of Indian mythology. It features a unique procedural skill tree which changes on every play-through.

525040.name: The Disney Afternoon Collection
525040.short_description: Starring a cast of beloved Disney characters, The Disney Afternoon Collection takes you back to a golden era of gaming and afternoons filled with adventure. All six classic games feature new and improved visuals and include filtering options that replicate a retro look and feel.

525480.name: .hack//G.U. Last Recode
525480.short_description: .hack//G.U. is back! This collection includes all 3 original .hack//G.U. titles, Rebirth, Reminisce, and Redemption, all fully restored and remastered. As well as an all new 4th Volume: .hack//G.U. Reconnection.

525690.name: MMM: Murder Most Misfortunate
525690.short_description: A gruesome murder interrupts an evening party at a secluded mansion and you are the prime suspect! Explore the mansion, search for clues, and interrogate the other guests as you strive to unmask the killer in this open-ended mystery.

526160.name: The Wild Eight
526160.short_description: The Wild Eight is an intense survival action-adventure set in the frozen wilderness of Alaska. Team up with friends in online co-op or go solo, explore the mysterious land, craft weapons and fight to live another day.

526540.name: 8infinity
526540.short_description: 8infinity (8 infinity) is a dynamic and rhythm game where the player reaches eights “8” - levels of infinity.

526740.name: hack_me
526740.short_description: Hack_me is a hacker simulator game. The main objective in game – is to hack big companies's servers to show people that there is nothing in this world that protected on 100%. You’ll need to use your cmd, bruteforce, SQL-injectors and other programs to hack servers.

526790.name: Monsti
526790.short_description: Playing Monsti is easy, all you have to do is to click and fly for as much time as you can. There will be many obstacles that come your way and you have to do all in your power in order to avoid them.

526870.name: Satisfactory
526870.short_description: Satisfactory is a first-person open-world factory building game with a dash of exploration and combat. Play alone or with friends, explore an alien planet, create multi-story factories, and enter conveyor belt heaven!

526880.name: Chess Knight 2
526880.short_description: A medieval world of strategy and tactics await you to engage in epic battles of wits as you master the moves and the strategies in a conquest to claim the kingdom of Chess.

526920.name: SQUAKE
526920.short_description: The mix of Snake+Quake! Quite clever, eh? We thought so. SQUAKE is a massive multiplayer action-packed combat-trains game! Collect wagons to become longer. Destroy other trains and try to not die by hitting yourself, because that would be totally embarrassing.

527100.name: Star Trek™: Bridge Crew
527100.short_description: Star Trek™: Bridge Crew, playable in both VR and non-VR, will immerse you in the Star Trek universe. In co-op, form a crew of four players to serve in the roles of Captain, Helm, Tactical or Engineer. Make strategic decisions and coordinate actions with your crew.

527230.name: For The King
527230.short_description: For The King is a strategic RPG that blends tabletop and roguelike elements in a challenging adventure that spans the realms. Set off on a single player experience or play cooperatively both online and locally.

527380.name: Captain Kaon
527380.short_description: Captain Kaon is a retro twin-stick gravity shooter inspired by 1980s classics such as Thrust and Gravitar. Captain Kaon pairs vibrant Amiga-style pixel art with a tight twin-stick control mechanic. Relive this forgotten shmup sub-genre!

527710.name: Crown Champion: Legends of the Arena
527710.short_description: "Crown Champion: Legends of the Arena" is a fantasy RPG/Management simulator set in the ruthless world of gladiatorial combat. Develop your academy and train your fighters. Increase your power and influence in the realm. Reap the rewards of your labours.

527750.name: Merger 3D
527750.short_description: 2048AD - the year in which humanity was faced with bio-terrorism. The desire to reach the next stage of evolution, which ran contrary to the facts of nature, formed the study of illegal modification to human cells. Because of this, a special unit was formed by mercenaries who opposed human experimentation.

527760.name: Just Hero
527760.short_description: Just Hero - a classic platformer about a green man in a hat which, by the will of destiny, is meant to become a hero. This game has it all: an intricate storyline, betrayal, death, tragedy, and finally, revenge!

527770.name: Russian SuperHero Dead Ivan
527770.short_description: Somewhere, in the farthest corner of Russia, you can find him: the great Russian superhero Dead Ivan! Surrounded by the most common stereotypes, he's armed with a chainsaw full of magic and is always ready for a fight!

527790.name: Cranium Conundrum
527790.short_description: Cranium Conundrum is a physics-based puzzle platformer taking place in the dream worlds that you create!

527990.name: Gladiator Trainer
527990.short_description: Rise through the ranks and lead your band of Gladiators to glory. Can you build the ultimate fighting force and a kingdom to rule all! Be careful who you trust. Becoming a Gladiator Trainer isn't easy.

528070.name: Solitaire Beach Season
528070.short_description: Solitaire Beach Season is a new card game set in exotic seaside locations. 120 summertime levels await you!

528180.name: Agricola: All Creatures Big and Small
528180.short_description: Agricola: All Creatures Big & Small is a digital adaptation of Uwe Rosenberg's award-winning two-player board game featuring farming and livestock breeding.

528230.name: SYNTHETIK: Legion Rising
528230.short_description: SYNTHETIK is an unforgiving tactical shooter rogue-lite where freedom and experimentation is key. Fight in a world overrun by the Machine Legion and their Gods. Experience the next level in gun-play and dive into unparalleled build options and Android upgrades. Can you defeat the Heart of Armageddon?

528250.name: Patchwork
528250.short_description: In the long-awaited digital adaptation of Uwe Rosenberg's Patchwork, players patch their way to victory using fabric pieces of assorted sizes, colors, and buttons.

528510.name: Turbo Pug 3D
528510.short_description: Turbo Pug is back! And this time, he's three dimensional! Join Turbo Pug and friends, sprint your way through a randomly generated voxel world with scaling difficulty. Turbo Pug 3D - Fast paced, casual fun.

528660.name: Spin Rush
528660.short_description: Spin Rush is 2D arcade game, where you have to collect dots and match colors.

528720.name: Shu
528720.short_description: Shu is a stylish 2.5D platformer set in a beautiful and engrossing world. Guide Shu and a cast of beautifully hand-drawn characters as they run, jump and glide their way across exotic lands, forever pursued by the monstrous and unrelenting Storm. CAN YOU OUTRUN THE END OF THE WORLD?

528950.name: Nekuia
528950.short_description: Explosive, challenging, exhilarating! Nekuia is a 2D platformer involving exploration, adventure, speedruns and reflexes. This innovative and intense gameplay rewards speed and jump skills.

529340.name: Victoria 3
529340.short_description: Paradox Development Studio invites you to build your ideal society in the tumult of the exciting and transformative 19th century. Balance the competing interests in your society and earn your place in the sun in Victoria 3, one of the most anticipated games in Paradox’s history.

529440.name: Behold the Kickmen
529440.short_description: BEHOLD THE KICKMEN is a football game made by someone who has no understanding of, or interest in, what is affectionately known as "The Wonderful Game". Start at the bottom of the Big Boring Football Spreadsheet and grind your way up to become the best at the football anyone's ever seen.

529480.name: Chopper: Lethal darkness
529480.short_description: Chopper: Lethal darkness is a shooter, where we are using FLIR Camera to find and destroy enemy bases, using air-to-surface guided missiles, infra-red guided missiles, and 30-mm machinegun.

529660.name: Mages of Mystralia
529660.short_description: In a world of magic, your mind is your greatest weapon. Learn the ways of magic and design your own spells to fight enemies, navigate treacherous terrain, and right past wrongs in the kingdom of Mystralia.

529760.name: TAIKU MANSION
529760.short_description: Trapped. Isolated. Alone. Use your cunning wit and intelligence to survive the puzzles lay in front of you by a mysterious figure. Escape from the mansion before dawn or face your demise. Do you have what it takes?

530020.name: World to the West
530020.short_description: World to the West is a standalone followup of Teslagrad, the indie hit that sold more than 1.6 million copies worldwide. A vast world of blue skies and dark caves awaits you in this 3D action adventure, as you try to unveil the mysteries of an ancient prophecy.

530320.name: Wandersong
530320.short_description: A musical platforming adventure with an emotional story. Play as a silly bard and use music to interact with everything on a journey around the world. Along the way you'll explore, solve puzzles, and meet a huge cast of characters!

530920.name: Archimedes
530920.short_description: After you purchase and install Archimedes, an old operating system appears to be running, and a strange man asks for your help as you start to discover the terrible secrets behind the game.

530930.name: Soulblight
530930.short_description: Soulblight is a dark, unforgiving, top-down action roguelike luring you to cross the thin line between good and evil. Embrace your flaws to survive a journey through an unforgiving Sanctuary. Gluttony, Lust, Cannibalism - how far are you willing to go?

530950.name: Tower 57
530950.short_description: Tower 57 is a fast-paced neo-retro shooter where cooperation is as important as your ammo capacity. As a member of an extraordinary task force fight your way through a dieselpunk megatower and uncover its hidden secrets.

531860.name: Where's My What?
531860.short_description: Where’s My What is a simple yet highly addictive game where you must identify and select a certain number of items on the screen before time runs out! While it sounds simple, it quickly becomes a dash against the clock as you pinpoint the right items in dozens of included categories.

531890.name: Guardian's Oath
531890.short_description: Physics and dynamic fighting based Action RPG

531930.name: Dungeon Rats
531930.short_description: A turn-based, party-based RPG set in the Age of Decadence world and focused on squad level tactical combat. Fight your way out of prison mine or die trying.

532110.name: Rusty Lake: Roots
532110.short_description: Experience the beginning and end of characters' lives and build your own family tree! Rusty Lake: Roots is the second premium point-and-click adventure by the creators of the Cube Escape series and Rusty Lake Hotel.

532210.name: Life is Strange 2
532210.short_description: After a tragic incident, brothers Sean and Daniel Diaz run away from home. Fearing the police, and dealing with Daniel's new telekinetic power, the boys head to Mexico. Each stop on their journey brings new friends and new challenges.

532600.name: Sweet Candy Mahjong
532600.short_description: Sweet Candy Mahjong is the latest installment to the popular series of casual games by award-winning EnsenaSoft and is the sweetest Mahjong game you will ever play!

533320.name: Space Trucker
533320.short_description: Set in the future of a Cold War that never ended, Space Trucker is a FPS that takes you on a journey that spans the galaxy. You play as Vladimir Gagarin, a young russian who just wants to go home.

533660.name: Ziggy's Chase
533660.short_description: Never mind the plumber, the hedgehog is coming to Steam! THE GAME FEATURES CLASSIC GAMEPLAY, AND VR MODE AS WELL.

533820.name: Atonement 2: Ruptured by Despair
533820.short_description: Three weeks have passed since the events of Atonement: Scourge of Time, but the world is yet in peril. Elleria and her allies find themselves in an alternate timeline where events took a grimmer turn. She will now have to go head to head against her other self in order to stop the impending threat.

534290.name: Cursed Castilla (Maldita Castilla EX)
534290.short_description: Cursed Castilla (Maldita Castilla EX) is an arcade action platformer full of creatures from medieval myths from Spain and the rest of Europe, as well as from chivalric romances. The extended version of the classic Maldita Castilla, originally created by the indie Locomalito.

534360.name: Colt Express
534360.short_description: Plan your hold up, adapt your scheme, get rich and get out! The game inspired from the famous train robbery boardgame!

534550.name: Guacamelee! 2
534550.short_description: Head back to the Mexiverse in this long-awaited sequel to the smash hit Guacamelee! Uppercut your way to victory across stunning new hand-crafted levels. Featuring a dense and colorful world, new luchador moves, sassy new bosses, twice the enemies, and 300% more chickens!

535480.name: Sundered®: Eldritch Edition
535480.short_description: Sundered is a chaotic hand­-drawn metroidvania where you resist or embrace ancient eldritch powers, a challenging and unique take on a classic genre from the creators of Jotun, now with local co-op!

535760.name: Unforgiving Trials: The Space Crusade
535760.short_description: The world is dying. Many years after the banishment of the evil that plagued the land, the world was hit by waves of unbearable heat. Now in order to save the world the band of young adventurers have set upon a quest to vanquish the Sun.

535930.name: Two Point Hospital
535930.short_description: Design stunning hospitals, cure peculiar illnesses and manage troublesome staff as you spread your budding healthcare organisation across Two Point County.

536220.name: The Walking Dead: A New Frontier
536220.short_description: After society was ripped apart by undead hands, pockets of civilization emerge from the chaos. But at what cost? Can the living be trusted on this new frontier?

536270.name: Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey
536270.short_description: Survive your evolution in Neogene Africa starting 10 million years ago. Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey is a third-person open world survival game where you Explore, Expand, and Evolve to advance your clan to the next generation in the exciting new adventure from Panache Digital Games.

536890.name: Glittermitten Grove
536890.short_description: Just like the faeries in your garden, we love collecting berries for our prickleberry loaves and finding treasure with our special fribblesham fireworks. Come join us in our faerieland, full of strange adventure!

537340.name: Guts and Glory
537340.short_description: A game about father and son riding their bicycle through obstacle courses of death, and other fun family experiences. Created by HakJak

537430.name: Inner Chains
537430.short_description: An FPS horror game set in a surreal, dark and deadly biomechanical world never seen before. Humankind is just a small part of a hostile universe. Want to survive? Discover its secrets.

537520.name: SYMMETRY
537520.short_description: A research spaceship reaches an abandoned planet. Nothing is what it seems here and the situation quickly slips out of control. Can the crew manage to survive and get back home?

537700.name: Octave
537700.short_description: Octave is a point 'n click horror-adventure game with elements of action. Dark woods, monsters, paranormal activity, nice puzzles - all this is present in the game.

537800.name: Bomber Crew
537800.short_description: Chocks away! Bomber Crew is a strategic simulation game, where picking the right crew and keeping your bomber in tip top shape is the difference between completing your mission or losing it all! USAAF DLC NOW AVAILABLE! FLY THE ICONIC AMERICAN BOMBER!

538060.name: Doodle God: 8-bit Mania - Collector's Item
538060.short_description: Every Element & Reaction Have Been Beautifully Redrawn with this amazing 8-bit skin to original Doodle God. If You Loved Doodle God - try this unique version of one of the most original games in the world.

538070.name: Bad Dream: Coma
538070.short_description: Welcome in Bad Dream: Coma. A point & click game where unique minimalistic art style creates an unforgettable and atmospheric experience. Travel through the surreal and disturbing dreamland where everything depends on your actions. You can't die but you can suffer greatly...

538840.name: City Climber
538840.short_description: City Climber is a silly physics-based game about a floppy ragdoll climber, who has to save the world. Find your way through diverse hand-crafted environments and enjoy funny challenges full of falling and destruction.

539440.name: Citalis
539440.short_description: Citalis is a fast paced city simulation game where you must carefully manage your city to avoid crime and disasters such as floods and droughts - all whilst making a profit!

539450.name: Crab Dub
539450.short_description: Deep deep down at the bottom of the ocean is where the evil Dr. Taco reigns. His biggest dream is to conquer the entire ocean. Together with his business partner, Mr. Rhino, they sponsor a high-tech project called «Crab Dub».

539460.name: Puzzle Cube
539460.short_description: Three in a row, but in 3d!

539470.name: Police Stories
539470.short_description: A fresh take on top-down shooters with an emphasis on tactics that forces you to make split second decisions. Neutralize criminals, rescue civilians and defuse bombs in Single Player mode or Co-op. And remember - shooting first is not an option!

540020.name: Final Quest II
540020.short_description: Return to the world of Paylea in Final Quest II. In an action-packed adventure, join Ralph and friends on an epic voyage to find his lost father. Have you got what it takes to confront the Dormai Empire?

540840.name: Lara Croft GO
540840.short_description: Lara Croft GO is a turn based puzzle-adventure set in a long-forgotten world. Explore the ruins of an ancient civilization, discover well-kept secrets and face deadly challenges as you uncover the myth of the Queen of Venom.

541200.name: GTTOD
541200.short_description: RISE. FALL. REPEAT. Ascend to the level of the Gods as you battle your way out of a shattered and chaotic dimension in this fast paced parkour FPS rogue-like.

541230.name: Alien Shooter TD
541230.short_description: Innovative Tower Defense inspired by legendary Alien Shooter series! The game was created in keeping with the best traditions of Sigma`s games, no concessions of any kind - everything is just like in real life!

542050.name: Forgotton Anne
542050.short_description: Step into a hand-animated realm of wonder in which everyday objects take on a life of their own. Uncover the Forgotlings’ mysteries & harness magical forces as you embark upon a quest to return home.

542260.name: The Herbalist
542260.short_description: "The Herbalist" is a smooth and meditative game from the creators of "Everlasting Summer". You'll need to recreate some recipes of ancient potions with Slavya.

542350.name: Castle of no Escape 2
542350.short_description: Explore 6 x 6 x 6 = 216 rooms of randomly generated hazards and enemies while collecting the necessary artefacts. Hundreds of monsters are roaming inside, guarding the sword shards — the last known thing to be capable of defeating the demonic castle owner.

542400.name: Pixel Gladiator
542400.short_description: Distant future… Brutal gladiatorial battles is a top-rated show, extremely popular all over the Universe. You’ve been sent to the abandoned planet as one of the participants of the show. Your goal is to survive as long as possible, fighting back deadly creatures in the focus of billions of viewers.

542550.name: Plankton
542550.short_description: Minimalist style game : plankton simulation, an electronic pet generated by math codes. Under your care it will slowly grow up and evolve.

542690.name: Mahsung Deluxe
542690.short_description: Mahsung Deluxe is a unique blend of mahjong, concentration and puzzle solving cleverly combined into a single great game with 50 mind-bending challenges.

542710.name: Dessert Storm
542710.short_description: Dessert Storm is the sweetest Match-3 puzzler you will ever play! Your task is to switch desserts in order to match lines of three of more. An adorable ice cream man will cheer you along as you complete randomized puzzles.

542720.name: Bubble Blowout
542720.short_description: There are bubbles everywhere in Bubble Blowout! Use your cannon at the bottom of the screen to match-3 or more bubbles, and clear the entire screen to progress.

542730.name: Block Blowout
542730.short_description: Block Blowout offers original brick-breaker arcade action inspired by the timeless classic. Blast your way through 84 challenging levels and collect useful upgrades and weapons of mass-destruction.

542740.name: Balloon Blowout
542740.short_description: Balloon Blowout invites you to pop weird and wacky balloons! In this colorful puzzler, balloons have escaped and you must pop them all before they get away. You get points for each popped balloon and additional points for grouped balloons or for popping balloons of identical color.

542930.name: Painted Memories
542930.short_description: Painted Memories is an Action/Adventure game that you journey through using various equipment in your arsenal, such as a crossbow or a torch. You will encounter different creatures, bosses, puzzles and more!

543460.name: Dead Rising 4
543460.short_description: Dead Rising 4 marks the return of photojournalist Frank West in an all-new chapter of one of the most popular zombie game franchises of all time. With an unmatched level of weapon and character customization, ambitious new features including new zombie classes and EXO Suits, Dead Rising 4 delivers a heart-pounding experience as players...

544140.name: Murder Mystery Adventure
544140.short_description: Murder Mystery Adventure tells the suspenseful story of a chilling murder committed in a mysterious mansion upon the hillside at the outskirts of town. Only you can solve the crime. Only you have the wits to solve challenging puzzles to unveil critical clues.

544330.name: Snake Pass
544330.short_description: Slither, coil and climb your way to the top of Haven Tor in this one of a kind physics based, puzzle platform adventure from award winning independent studio Sumo Digital!

544610.name: Battlestar Galactica Deadlock
544610.short_description: In Battlestar Galactica Deadlock™ you’ll take command of the Colonial Fleet in defense of the Twelve Colonies during the First Cylon War. Lead many different types of ships in this 3D tactical game. Every decision counts, your strategy will be vital – can you ensure mankind’s survival?

544750.name: SOULCALIBUR VI
544750.short_description: Bring more than your fists to the fight! Featuring all-new battle mechanics and characters, SOULCALIBUR VI marks a new era of the historic franchise. Welcome back to the stage of history!

545040.name: Feather
545040.short_description: Feather is a multiplayer game about exploration, relaxation and immersion. Transform yourself into a bird, take flight, and enjoy a zen-like, picturesque landscape on your own terms. Swoop, glide, and backflip your way around mysterious locations to uncover hidden paths that only birds can follow!

545270.name: NBA Playgrounds
545270.short_description: Classic NBA arcade action is back! Take your “A” game to the playground and beat the best in high-flying 2-on-2 basketball action. Practice your skills offline, play with up to three others and take your talents online to posterize your opponents with acrobatic jams and ridiculous displays of skill.

545410.name: A Trip to Yugoslavia: Director's Cut
545410.short_description: A TRIP TO YUGOSLAVIA is an experimental interactive game with a theme of the old VCR player (with the ability to REWIND, PAUSE and FASTFORWARD).

545690.name: VOI
545690.short_description: Do you think 1 + 1 = 0 is correct? So what do you think about "black + black = white" statement?

545700.name: The Land of Dasthir
545700.short_description: Join Terret in his small, but dangerous adventure through a mysterious and forgotten land of Dasthir

545920.name: Hunting Unlimited 4
545920.short_description: Hunting Unlimited 4 combines traditional hunting game elements with a fast-paced mission-based system, for intense hunting action.

546090.name: Trip to Vinelands
546090.short_description: Trip to Vinelands is an arcade retro hardcore maze wanderer minigame.

546200.name: Gnomes Garden 3: The thief of castles
546200.short_description: Gnomes Garden 3 — a new chapter in this exciting fantasy/strategy game. Head off into unknown lands and defeat the warlock!

546230.name: Xenus 2. White gold.
546230.short_description: Caribbean islands; islands full of secrets, mystery and the spirit of romance. These islands are both beautiful and lethally dangerous. Centuries ago the waters of this region were teeming with pirates and adventurers... and frankly, not much has changed since then.

546400.name: Cavern Escape Extremely Hard game!!!
546400.short_description: Cavern escape is new platformer puzzle game.

546410.name: Grab the Bottle
546410.short_description: Grab the Bottle is a puzzle game in which you solve puzzles by stretching an infinitely stretchy arm through various levels, grabbing and dropping objects along the way.

546430.name: Pathway
546430.short_description: Explore the strange unknown with Pathway, a strategy adventure set in the 1930s great wilderness. Unravel long-forgotten mysteries of the occult, raid ancient tombs and outwit your foes in turn-based squad combat!

546550.name: Snowball!
546550.short_description: Roll behemoth snow spheres through a handcrafted world of winter pinball surprises. Discover hidden mechanics to chain huge score combos and master the maze while enjoying the 16-bit pixel art and a 'chilled-out' soundtrack.

546700.name: The Butterfly Sign
546700.short_description: The Butterfly Sign is a detective story putting players into the role of the survivor of a disastrous incident. The protagonist takes an experimental drug which immerses him in the depths of his mind. In his memories, he will discover the ones responsible for the disaster, little by little, step by step…

546980.name: Midnight Carnival
546980.short_description: Midnight Carnival is a Visual Novel with a dark and disturbing story and theme.

546990.name: Town of Night
546990.short_description: Town of Night is a RPG-First-person dungeon crawler hybrid. Visit the town that sits atop a series of vast and dangerous dungeons. Explore, battle, loot and survive!

547930.name: Precursors
547930.short_description: Precursors, predecessors, the legend of galaxy… Who are carrying the forebear’s genes among existing races, we can suppose only… Worlds of galaxy are everlasting, beautiful, unique and dangerous. Some of them are inhabited, some ruined and deserted, other - just a smugglers trans-shipment stations.

548080.name: Space Merchants: Arena
548080.short_description: Space Merchants: Arena is a cross-platform online multiplayer game where futuristic spaceships engage in intense dogfights.3 game modes: Free for all/Team battle/Capture the Artefact.4 different maps: Faarlands, Tristar, Jupiter, Naussike system.Online leaderboards

548430.name: Deep Rock Galactic
548430.short_description: Deep Rock Galactic is a 1-4 player co-op FPS featuring dwarven space miners, procedurally-generated destructible environments, and endless hordes of alien monsters. Explore cave systems, mine for minerals, and work together to survive!

549260.name: Alwa's Awakening
549260.short_description: Use your magic staff and progress through a large interconnected world where you'll solve puzzles, fight enemies and defeat bosses in order to help free the land of Alwa. Explore and uncover the secrets by using your platforming skills in this challenging and charming 8-bit adventure game.

550310.name: Root Of Evil: The Tailor
550310.short_description: You will play a telepath named James. He has the ability to connect with the soul thus he can understand their past. He was hired to explore what happened in the previous 20 years in a haunted house This is the puzzle game!

550390.name: Kingdom of Aurelia: Mystery of the Poisoned Dagger
550390.short_description: In this steam punk adventure you have to help young Sam to save Princess Aurora and stop the villain, who intended to seize power in the Kingdom of Aurelia.

551190.name: 123 Slaughter Me Street 2
551190.short_description: In this exciting prequel to the hit game "123 Slaughter Me Street", we find out the deep dark secrets that lead up to the madness of this series. You find yourself confused with blood on your hands in a dark house with only a flashlight to guide you.

551770.name: ECHO
551770.short_description: After a century in stasis the girl En arrives at her destination: A Palace out of legend. Out here, using forgotten technologies, she hopes to bring back a life that shouldn’t have been lost. But nothing could prepare her for what she’ll face in the ancient halls below.

552410.name: Project Abyss
552410.short_description: Project Abyss is a deep sea adventure game where you explore as a diver, forced to survive a destiny that goes deeper than anyone imagined.

552500.name: Warhammer: Vermintide 2
552500.short_description: The critically acclaimed Vermintide 2 is a visually stunning and groundbreaking melee action game pushing the boundaries of the first person co-op genre. Join the fight now!

552520.name: Far Cry® 5
552520.short_description: Discover the open world of Hope County, Montana, besieged by a fanatical doomsday cult. Dive into the action solo or two-player co-op in the story campaign, use a vast arsenal of weapons and allies, and free Hope County from Joseph Seed and his cult.

552590.name: The Sexy Brutale
552590.short_description: The Sexy Brutale — a never-ending masked ball featuring intrigue, murder and the (quite possibly) occult! Relive the same mysterious day where the guests at the casino mansion are being murdered by the staff over and over again...

552900.name: Fields XY
